items.stem: By the time he arrived, the film ____ for ten minutes.
items.explanation: by the time 加过去时要求过去完成，for 加时间段须用延续状态 be on。begun 是短暂动词，has been on 时态不对。

items.stem: She said she ____ the book twice.
items.explanation: 主句 said 是过去时，转述更早的完成动作用过去完成时 had read。其余时态与 said 不呼应。

items.stem: I ____ my homework when he called me.
items.explanation: 电话来时作业已完成，先发生的动作用过去完成时 had finished。其余时态没有体现先后顺序。

items.stem: The train ____ before we got to the station.
items.explanation: 到站前火车已开走，过去的过去用过去完成时 had left。has left 与现在相关，left 与 leaves 不表先后。

items.stem: —Why didn't you answer the phone? —I ____ a shower.
items.explanation: 未接电话时正在洗澡，用过去进行时 was taking。其余时态都不能表示当时正在进行。

items.stem: He ____ in this factory since he left school.
items.explanation: since 加过去时从句，主句用现在完成时 has worked。其余时态与 since 结构不配套。

items.stem: The bridge ____ by the end of last year.
items.explanation: by the end of last year 加被动语态，须用过去完成时被动 had been completed。其余时态与被动都不符。

items.stem: —How long ____ you ____ in Kunming? —Since 2010.
items.explanation: How long 加 since 用现在完成时 have lived。did 与 do 配一般时，are living 是进行时形式。

items.stem: I don't know if he ____ tomorrow. If he ____, I'll call you.
items.explanation: 第一处 if 引导宾语从句表是否，用将来时；第二处 if 引导条件从句用一般现在时。其余组合都把两处混为一类。

items.stem: If I ____ you, I would accept the offer.
items.explanation: 与现在事实相反的虚拟条件句，be 动词统一用 were。am 与 was 不表虚拟，will be 属真实条件句。

items.stem: If he ____ harder, he would have passed the exam.
items.explanation: 与过去事实相反，从句用 had 加过去分词，主句用 would have done。其余形式不构成过去虚拟。

items.stem: I wish I ____ as tall as my brother.
items.explanation: wish 后从句表与现在事实相反，be 动词用 were。am 表真实，will be 与 be 都不合虚拟要求。

items.stem: He suggested that we ____ the meeting until next week.
items.explanation: suggest 后的从句用虚拟语气，动词取原形 put off。putted 是错误变形，puts 与 putting 不合该结构。

items.stem: It is important that every student ____ the rule.
items.explanation: It is important that 从句用虚拟语气，动词取原形 follow。第三人称单数、分词、过去式都不符合。

items.stem: The reason why he was late is ____ he got up late.
items.explanation: The reason is that 是固定搭配，表语从句用 that 引导。because 会造成因果重复，why 与 for 结构不合。

items.stem: It was in the park ____ I met my old friend.
items.explanation: 强调句型 It was 加被强调的地点状语加 that，不用 where。which 指物，where 与 when 在此结构不合。

items.stem: Not until he came back ____ the truth.
items.explanation: Not until 置于句首时主句部分倒装，用 did he know。其余三项都是陈述语序，不合倒装规则。

items.stem: Only in this way ____ improve your English.
items.explanation: Only 加状语置于句首时主句倒装，情态动词提前为 can you。其余各项或未倒装或时态与语境不合。

items.stem: So tired ____ that he fell asleep at once.
items.explanation: so 加形容词置于句首时主句倒装，was 提前。其余形式未倒装或时态与 fell 不搭。

items.stem: Neither he nor I ____ interested in the film.
items.explanation: neither…nor 连接主语时按就近原则，靠近的 I 决定用 am。is 与 are 都不符合就近一致。

items.stem: Either you or he ____ to go there.
items.explanation: either…or 连接主语时按就近原则，靠近的 he 用 has。have、are、were 都与 he 不一致。

items.stem: The number of students in our school ____ about 1200.
items.explanation: the number of 意为数量，作主语时谓语用单数 is。a number of 才接复数谓语，其余形式时态也错。

items.stem: Neither of the two answers ____ correct.
items.explanation: neither of 作主语时谓语用单数 is。are 与 were 是复数形式，be 是原形不作谓语。

items.stem: The police ____ looking for the missing child.
items.explanation: police 作主语表示警察全体，谓语用复数 are。is 与 was 是单数，has 是单数完成形式。

items.stem: 下面哪个词与 finally 意思最接近（　）
items.explanation: finally 意为最终，对应 at last。at first 表起初，at once 表立刻，at times 表有时。

items.stem: He ____ the truth at last.
items.explanation: find out 表示查明真相。find 意为找到实体，look for 意为寻找过程，look 是不及物看。

items.stem: The meeting was ____ because of the heavy rain.
items.explanation: put off 表示推迟，与原因状语搭配合理。put on 意为穿上，put up 意为搭建，put away 意为收起来。

items.stem: I can't ____ the noise outside.
items.explanation: can't 后接动词原形 stand，意为忍受。其余形式含过去式、分词或第三人称单数，都不合情态动词用法。

items.stem: She ____ up smoking two years ago.
items.explanation: two years ago 用一般过去时 gave up，意为戒掉。given 是过去分词，gives 与 giving 时态或形式不合。

items.stem: Please ____ the light before you leave.
items.explanation: 离开前应关灯，用 turn off。turn on 是打开，turn up 调大音量，turn down 调小音量。

items.stem: We should ____ the environment by not littering.
items.explanation: should 后接动词原形 protect。protects、protecting、protected 都不合情态动词后面的形式要求。

items.stem: —Would you like some tea? —____
items.explanation: 接受 Would you like 的邀请用 Yes, please。其余答语或语法不完整，或用 I do 回应与 would 无关的助动词。

items.stem: —Thank you for your help. —____
items.explanation: 回应感谢用 You're welcome。No, thanks 回应提议，That's right 表示判断正确，Never mind 回应道歉。

items.stem: —Sorry, I'm late. —____
items.explanation: 回应道歉用 Never mind，意为没关系。另三句分别回应感谢、确认判断、回应请求。

items.stem: —Could you help me carry the box? —____
items.explanation: 答应请求用 Sure, I can。另三句回应感谢或道歉，不能用来应允帮助。

items.stem: Which of the following is the right passive form of「他们昨天修好了这台机器」（　）
options: The machine repaired by them yesterday.
The machine was repaired by them yesterday.
The machine is repaired by them yesterday.
The machine has repaired by them yesterday.
items.explanation: 过去时间加被动语态为 was repaired 加 by 加施动者。其余各项缺助动词、时态不符或语态错误。

items.stem: He is the man ____ helped me yesterday.
items.explanation: 先行词 the man 指人且在从句作主语，用 who。which 指物，whose 作定语，what 不能引导定语从句。

items.stem: This is the factory ____ my father works.
items.explanation: 先行词 factory 表地点且从句完整，用关系副词 where。which 与 that 需在从句中作成分。

items.stem: The more careful you are, ____ mistakes you will make.
items.explanation: the 加比较级对照结构表示越……越……，此句应填 the fewer。缺 the 或用 more 都会改变语义。

items.stem: 下面哪一句是宾语从句的正确语序（　）
options: I don't know when will he come.
I don't know when does he come.
I don't know when he will come.
I don't know when he does come.
items.explanation: 宾语从句用陈述语序 when he will come。倒装形式与 does come 强调结构都不符合从句要求。
